I’ve been dealing with a stomach issue for the past 50 days and have to call every single day at 8:00 AM to book an appointment. I’ve already visited the GP more than 15–16 times during this period, and on other days, I went to the hospital. The hospital advised me to contact my GP for an endoscopy, but the GP has only done blood tests (three times) and stool tests (twice) and prescribed medicines that haven’t worked. I have to take 3–4 painkillers per day just to get through the pain, but they still haven’t taken steps like arranging an endoscopy, which could actually help determine what’s wrong.

What’s worse is that, according to the NHS app, they have recorded visits that never happened. Despite being in severe pain, I cannot get timely appointments. I’ve been unable to work because of this ongoing issue.

When I called this morning at 9:00 AM, I waited over 20 minutes only to be told that all appointments for the day were gone. I asked if they could book me an appointment for tomorrow, but the receptionist abruptly hung up on me. This level of care is both disrespectful and unacceptable.

Additionally, during my first visit, they handed me a form to fill out praising their services, which now feels completely inappropriate given the circumstances. I am writing this because I am in pain and deeply frustrated—50 days of suffering without proper treatment is far too much.
